items.title: Gene regulation ki ahmiyat aur tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene regulation (PDF 141-142).

blocks.text: Regulation cells ko mahol ke halaat ka jawab dene aur zaroorat par proteins banane deti hai. Kaseer-ul-khaliya (multicellular) jandaron mein yeh cells ki tafreeq (differentiation) aur shakal sazi (morphogenesis) ki bunyad hai, jis se aik genome wale lekin mukhtalif genes zahir karne wale cells bante hain.

Regulation kai darjon par hoti hai: transcription ki raftaar, transcription ke baad mRNA ki tabdeeli, translation ki raftaar, aur translation ke baad protein ki tabdeeli (us ka murna, istehkaam waghaira).

items: Negative regulation: repressors naam ke regulatory proteins promoter ke qareeb operators naam ke DNA hisson se jur kar RNA polymerase ko rokte aur transcription band ya kam karte hain.
Positive regulation: activators naam ke regulatory proteins regulatory site se jur kar RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad dete aur transcription shuru ya tez karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Positive gene regulation: activator operator se jura ho to promoter par RNA polymerase gene transcribe karta hai; activator na ho to transcription nahi. Negative gene regulation: repressor operator se jura ho to transcription nahi; repressor na ho to gene transcribe hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.21: Regulatory protein ke zariye positive aur negative gene regulation (kitab ki Figure 19.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har qataar mein promoter par RNA polymerase, operator aur gene, saath 'Transcription' ya 'No transcription'.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke activators (jinhein woh inducers bhi kehti hai) operators se jurte hain. Yeh sahi nahi: activators regulatory proteins hain jo promoter ke qareeb apni activator sites (maslan lac operon ki CAP site) se jurte hain; operator repressor ke jurne ki jagah hai. Inducer protein nahi balke chhota molecule (maslan allolactose) hai jo repressor se jur kar use bekaar kar deta hai, aur gene on ho jata hai.

Eukaryotes mein mRNA ki splicing ke dauran bhi genes on ya off ho sakte hain. Khaas cells ke khaas regulatory proteins mRNA ke hisse, introns ya exons, mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalte hain, is liye mukhtalif lambai ke mRNAs bante aur aik gene se aik se zyada polypeptides ban sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Template DNA (5' aur 3') jis mein chhe rangeen exons introns se alag hain; transcription se exons 1 se 6 wala immature mRNA; alternate splicing se teen mature mRNAs: 1 2 4 5 6, 1 3 5 6 aur 1 3 4 5 6; har aik ki translation se Polypeptide 1, 2 aur 3.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.22: Alternate splicing aur gene ki mukhtalif paidawar (kitab ki Figure 19.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Aik gene do mukhtalif proteins kaise de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Alternative splicing se: mukhtalif cells mein mukhtalif exons rakhe jate hain, jis se mukhtalif mRNAs aur is liye mukhtalif polypeptides bante hain.

items: Regulation se jawab, tafreeq aur shakal sazi.
Operator par repressor: off; activator: on ya tez.
Alternative splicing: aik gene se kai proteins.
